summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by British American Tobacco p.l.c., a foreign private issuer, furnished to the SEC under Rule 13a-16. The exhibit is a press release notifying a transfer of ordinary shares by a person discharging managerial responsibilities (James Murphy, Director, Research and Science) to a person closely associated with them. The transfer was at nil price, outside a trading venue, and involves 12,283 shares. No special situation is present.
